gloss: to stock, to purchase for resale

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {仕入|しい}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to stock, to purchase (goods for resale), to procure
definitions.explanation: To buy goods from a supplier or wholesaler for the purpose of selling them to customers. A fundamental business term in retail and commerce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕入|しい}れる。
examples.english: To stock up on fresh vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕入|しい}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Every morning I purchase fish at the market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧{仕入|しい}れた⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I sell products online that I purchased cheaply from overseas.

notes:
{仕入|しい}れる means to purchase goods from a supplier for the purpose of reselling them. A key business/commerce term.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕入|しい}れる: to purchase/stock goods
- ⟦{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}→仕入れ値：21592_shiirene⟧: purchase price, cost price
- ⟦{仕入|しい}れ→仕入れ：07431_shiire⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: supplier, vendor
- {仕入|しい}れ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: purchase price

ASPECT (ている):
{仕入|しい}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a habitual or ongoing procurement activity, e.g. ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕入|しい}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (I buy fish every morning).

USAGE:
Also used for acquiring information or knowledge: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕入|しい}れる (to gather/pick up information). This is a common figurative extension.

RELATED WORDS:
- {買|か}い{付|つ}ける: to buy in (more formal purchasing)
- ⟦{調達|ちょうたつ}→調達：09938_choutatsu⟧: procurement (broader, more formal)
